NJD.head: New Jersey has nearly everything going for it
NJD.body: New Jersey has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Anything short of a win would be a surprise, though Vancouver can make a game of it if it gets to the dangerous areas.

VAN.head: Everything points away from Vancouver
VAN.body: New Jersey has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver’s best hope is getting to the dangerous areas, plus a big night in goal.
